decisions_and_open_points: Bundle format follows design §6.5; schema_version 'collector_bundle.v1', index.json {bundles:[{source_id,date,run_id,finished_at}]}, status.json {sources:{<id>:{status,last_run_at,paused_reason}}}, bundle_sha256 = sha256 of sorted item content_sha256 joined by newline. COLLECTOR-STACK (A1) must emit exactly this or adjust the constants in connectors/collector_bundle.py.

Collector host comes from PANTHEON_COLLECTOR_HOST; unset it falls back to collector.pantheon-collector.invalid so the egress canary fails closed. Definition fingerprints therefore depend on that env at process start.

Registry has no paper/book class (papers belong to the seed registry, test_registry_split), so paper corpus and books use source_classes (news, paper|book); the first is the registry bucket, records stay source_type paper.
One rejected bundle fails the whole pull and blocks the cursor until fixed (fail-closed, visible as failing health).
docker-compose.yml only passes PANTHEON_COLLECTOR_HOST/PANTHEON_COLLECTOR_BUNDLE_TOKEN through; the allowlist steady state and refresh guard belong to DEV-EGRESS-COLLECTOR-HOST-GATE (A3).
Not done here: scheduler wiring that calls record_collector_observation after each pull, and numeric-series datasets for macro (B1).
